trap.label: who/that/which
trap.wrong: The woman who she called is my aunt.
trap.right: The woman who called is my aunt.
trap.why: O português repete o pronome na oração relativa; em inglês não. Também o aluno usa who para coisas.

mcq.q: The bag ___ is on the chair is mine.
The girl ___ won is my cousin.

opts: The man which helped me is kind.
The man who he helped me is kind.
The man who helped me is kind.

fix.wrong: The man who he works here is kind.
fix.right: The man who works here is kind.

fix.wrong: The cup who is broken is mine.
fix.right: The cup that is broken is mine.

fix.wrong: A bakery is a place which we buy bread.
fix.right: A bakery is a place where we buy bread.

rewrite.prompt: Junte com who: “I met a girl. She speaks French.”
rewrite.answer: I met a girl who speaks French.

rewrite.prompt: Junte com that: “I have a phone. It is new.”
rewrite.answer: I have a phone that is new.

rewrite.prompt: Junte com where: “That is the park. We play there.”
rewrite.answer: That is the park where we play.
